input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is the APPROVED COVENANT CREATURE SOURCE, the authority for anatomy, palette and painting style. Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. Four moth wings, one thorax and two antennae. Reaction bends thorax and sweeps wings; collapse folds intact wings low against the ground. No human limbs. Raw magical oversized moth, four ragged triangular midnight-blue wings, pale silver wing veins and moonlike empty markings, small dark segmented body and fine antennae, restrained lilac wisps. Clear wing silhouette, no human face. FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally TOWARD viewer and image RIGHT, face and front surfaces clearly visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly FIVE columns and TWO rows: TEN complete poses, same anatomical scale, no text. Read left to right: poses 1-4 QUICK FLINCH: 1 ready; 2 head and shoulders jerk backward visibly; 3 wings counter-sweep to catch balance; 4 fully recovered ready. Poses 5-10 HEAVY STAGGER: 5 ready; 6 abrupt head and torso recoil; 7 deepest hunched recoil and visibly lost balance; 8 wings sweep low to catch descent; 9 pushing back toward ready; 10 fully recovered ready. Show clear torso articulation and varied wing sweeps; not repeated standing duplicates. Four moth wings, six fine insect legs, thorax and two antennae. Keep hovering throughout, wing sweeps and thorax recoil, no human anatomy. No falling or lying poses in this sheet. The difference between ready and peak recoil must read at small game size. Wide empty gutters, no clipped parts. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only.

arguments.Prompt: Original painted game character 2D sprite ANIMATION SHEET on solid uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF background. Featuring the creature from Reference-1.png and Reference-2.png: Hush Moth, a magical oversized moth creature. ANIMAL ONLY: No human body, no humanoid torso, no human face, no clothes, no weapons, no hands, no human limbs. Exact creature anatomy: four ragged triangular midnight-blue moth wings with pale silver wing veins and faint moonlike markings, small dark segmented insect body/thorax/abdomen, six fine insect legs, and two delicate feathery antennae, with restrained lilac wisps. View angle: FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view (head and torso facing diagonally toward viewer and image-right, front surfaces and moth face clearly visible) from an elevated 55-degree orthographic camera angle. Consistent viewing angle across all poses. Hovering in the air throughout all poses (no falling or lying on ground). Layout & Grid: Exactly 5 columns and 2 rows, containing exactly 10 complete poses arranged in a clean grid, identical anatomical scale across all cells. Wide completely empty magenta (#FF00FF) gutters between cells and around borders. Each moth body fits well within the middle 60% of its grid cell. No clipped wings or antennae. No panel lines, no borders, no text, no numbers, no floor, no shadows on ground. Animation Breakdown (read left-to-right): Row 1 (Poses 1 to 5): Pose 1: Hovering ready idle stance, wings spread upright. Pose 2 (Quick Flinch 1): Head and thorax jerk backward visibly from impact. Pose 3 (Quick Flinch 2): Wings counter-sweep sharply forward to catch balance. Pose 4 (Quick Flinch 3): Fully recovered hovering ready stance. Pose 5: Hovering ready stance before heavy stagger. Row 2 (Poses 6 to 10 - Heavy Stagger): Pose 6 (Heavy Stagger 1): Abrupt violent recoil, head and thorax jerking sharply backward and upward. Pose 7 (Heavy Stagger 2): Deepest hunched recoil, thorax bent back, visibly lost balance and reeling. Pose 8 (Heavy Stagger 3): Wings sweep low and forward trying to catch descent while still hovering. Pose 9 (Heavy Stagger 4): Pushing upward and forward, stabilizing back toward neutral. Pose 10 (Heavy Stagger 5): Fully recovered hovering ready stance. Style: Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy art style matching Reference-1.png and Reference-2.png. Lighter stylized painted values and sculpted painterly shapes, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, smooth opaque paint. No realistic horror, no photoreal fur, no heavy cartoon outlines, no 3D render, no noise texture. Upper-left lighting.
